decision: For exactly the 677 original owner-33741 MRC residual keys whose native centres fall inside the retained official 2023 INEI Loreto department feature, treat the original MRC target’s Brazil-Amazonas territorial exclusion contact as historical/contextual rather than as a disqualifying source for this bounded parent-supported subset. The MRC target is the 2020 IGN/OCHA province feature PE1604; the official INEI 2017 roster identifies province 160400 Mariscal Ramón Castilla under Loreto, and the official INEI 2023 department feature identifies Loreto (code 16). This supports parent-level territorial source role only. It does not claim a legal boundary ruling, a newer-year rule, MRC feature-level overlay, whole-cell containment, cell acceptance, or credit.
